name: Jones, Robert Maynard
text: Jones, Robert Maynard, who wrote as Bobi Jones, was born in 1929. He grew up in Cardiff, the capital city of Wales. His household spoke no Welsh, yet he became a scholar of that tongue. He ranked among the first people from such a home to reach a university chair of the subject. He taught at Carmarthen and later at the University of Wales. He wrote a great many poems and critical works in Welsh. He was a firm Calvinist and a tireless defender of the language. He studied the medieval Welsh romances grouped as the Tair Rhamant. He helped establish the Welsh academy and a group that pairs adults learning Welsh with fluent speakers. His long research traced the theory of the letter and criticism.
